title: AI Works While You Sleep? OpenAI Dots Explained (The Real Catch)
description:
Imagine going to sleep with unfinished research and waking up to a draft, sources and a plan. OpenAI introduced dots, always-on personal AI agents with their own cloud computer and connected apps. In this practical original explainer, we use a FICTIONAL homework/research example to show how to write safer agent instructions, what a dot can work on, what still requires approval, and who can get access.

What you'll learn:
• The illustrated 11 PM → 9 AM research task
• A better prompt: three sources, draft only, flag uncertainties
• Minimal app connections and sensitive-action approvals
• Dots versus ordinary scheduled reminders
• Pro, Business Premium and administrator-enabled Enterprise beta eligibility, with gradual and regional rollout

IMPORTANT: Illustrative graphics are original reconstructions, not screenshots or a live OpenAI dots task. No actual dot was tested in this video. OpenAI's descriptions of the product are not a guarantee that every task will succeed. Start with read-only research and verify facts. Narration is synthetic, voiced in a natural conversational style.

Official OpenAI introduction: https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/
Getting started and current eligibility: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001530-getting-started-with-your-dot
Dots privacy, security and approval rules: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001529-dots-privacy-security-and-safety-faqs
Original motion design; background uses a licensed desk photograph previously incorporated into FlowMinute Lab's production assets.
